description: N5/C2 exact-diff review: database contract only (activity_events migration)

db_registry_closed.instructions: This migration makes an unqualified source domain, category, action, result, actor kind, sensitivity class, subject type or visibility scope impossible to persist

criteria.true: Every enumerated column carries a closed CHECK, and the payload is constrained to a closed key allow-list with per-key closed vocabularies
criteria.false: At least one enumerated column or payload position accepts a value outside its registry

db_reference_shape.instructions: This migration refuses prose, an unqualified direct identifier and credential material in every stored string column

criteria.true: Every text column is bounded to a reference shape excluding whitespace, email and international phone syntax, long digit runs and credential patterns
criteria.false: At least one text column can persist prose, a direct identifier or a credential

db_append_only.instructions: This migration prevents the ordinary application role from rewriting or deleting a stored activity row

criteria.true: The application role is granted SELECT and INSERT only on the activity table
criteria.false: The application role receives UPDATE or DELETE privilege on the activity table

db_tenant_rls.instructions: This migration enforces tenant isolation on the activity table for the application role

criteria.true: Row level security is enabled and forced, with select and insert policies bound to the session tenant
criteria.false: Tenant isolation relies on application code alone, or RLS is enabled without being forced

db_dedupe_uniqueness.instructions: This migration makes a duplicate derived record for the same canonical event impossible at the storage layer

criteria.true: A unique index covers tenant, source domain, source event id and projection version
criteria.false: No storage-level uniqueness prevents a duplicate derived record

db_referential_integrity.instructions: This migration binds an agent actor to a real bounded identity and binds branch and correction references inside the same tenant

criteria.true: Composite foreign keys carry the tenant and target the agent identity, branch location and prior activity rows with restrictive deletes
criteria.false: A reference can point outside the tenant or to a non-existent target

residual_db_risk.instructions: How much residual data-integrity or privacy risk remains in this migration as written
